name: dtg-witness
description: A DTG witness identity for vti-witness, the host service that witnesses exchanges between other parties and issues Verifiable Witness Credentials (witness/session/0.1, witness/session/submit/0.1). The witness is public by design: its DID is the session's recipient and the VWC's issuer, so it is its own did:webvh and never its operator VTA's (VTI-KEY-007). Declares an Ed25519 key (#key-0) that is both authentication (it answers Trust Tasks) and assertionMethod (it signs the VWCs it issues), and an X25519 key-agreement key (#key-1). Reachable over TSP and DIDComm through the mediator named by MEDIATOR_DID: both services name the same mediator, TSP first (canonical order), and the transport URL lives in that mediator's own document. Deliberately no VTARest and no other HTTP endpoint: v1 of the witness has no HTTPS door, because one would need a hostname of its own to avoid a naming correlator. URL or WEBVH_SERVER is still required at provision time so the VTA knows where to publish the did:webvh log itself, but neither appears in the rendered document. Host that log apart from the operator's own domains, and pick a mediator other than the operator VTA's: both are correlators `vti-witness setup` warns about.
